source:
@@U03991@@
Ah! I have it! Yes! What's fired you up so! Something exalted, I’m sure, not to say bold. With all your recent stratospheric travel, I suspect it’s the moon you're after.

@@U03993@@
No! Impossible! There’s room still on earth for great deeds. Astonishing things will be achieved. I feel in me the power for this bold enterprise.

@@U03995@@
Ah, then it’s fame you're after! That’s what comes from consorting with heroines.

@@U03997@@
No, not fame, fame is nothing. It’s action I want. I want possessions, power!

@@U03999@@
There'll be poets aplenty to sing your praise to posterity, and in doing so endlessly perpetuate your folly.

@@U04001@@
What do you know about human longing, human desire, human aspiration? You with your contrary nature, your hatred, your hostility! You know nothing of human need!

@@U04003@@
Well, then, by all means let’s hear. Let’s hear this latest craze. I’m all ears.
translation:
@@U03991@@
啊！我有！是的！什么事让你这么激动！我敢肯定，这是一种崇高的东西，更不用说是大胆的了。考虑到你最近的平流层旅行，我怀疑你正在寻找月球。

@@U03993@@
不！不可能的！地球上仍然有空间可以成就伟大的事迹。将会取得令人惊奇的事情。我感受到自己拥有推动这项大胆事业的力量。

@@U03995@@
啊，那你追求的就是名誉！这就是与女主角交往的结果。

@@U03997@@
不，不是名气，名气不算什么。这是我想要的行动。我要财产、权力！

@@U03999@@
将会有大量的诗人向后人歌颂你，并以此让你的愚蠢永垂不朽。

@@U04001@@
你对人类的渴望、人类的欲望、人类的抱负了解多少？你的本性相反，你的仇恨，你的敌意！你对人类的需求一无所知！

@@U04003@@
好吧，那么，无论如何，让我们听听吧。让我们来听听这最新的热潮。我洗耳恭听。
